card.label: S. 4668
card.summary: The Protect College Sports Act of 2026 establishes federal rules governing name, image, and likeness (NIL) agreements for college student athletes, creates limited antitrust exemptions for sports broadcasting rights, and sets standards for student health, safety, transfers, and scholarship protections. It also establishes a competitive grant program to improve broadband, technology, and sports media infrastructure at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).
